cues: For a negative or fractional power, the same formula still works, but the coefficients never become zero, so the series never stops.
One plus x to the n equals one plus n x plus n times n minus one over two factorial x squared, and so on forever.
An infinite series is only useful if it converges, and this one does only when the absolute value of x is less than one.
That condition is part of the answer: always state it.
